propertySets.name: Pset_FlowMeterTypeEnergyMeter
propertySets.definition: Device that measures, indicates and sometimes records, the energy usage in a system.

properties.name: NominalCurrent
properties.definition: The nominal current that is designed to be measured.

properties.name: MaximumCurrent
properties.definition: The maximum allowed current that a device is certified to handle.

properties.name: MultipleTarriff
properties.definition: Indicates whether meter has built-in support for multiple tarriffs (variable energy cost rates).
